# `aitbc crosschain stats`

Show cross-chain trading statistics from real persisted records.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc crosschain stats [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc crosschain stats
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc crosschain stats --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
